name: Fortune Wheel
description: A glossy wheel of answers behind the time: every time the watch wakes up it spins once, speeds up, slows down and stops on a random answer.

steps.script: await registerCustomFont({ name: 'open-sans-400.ttf', family: 'Open Sans Regular', format: 'truetype', ext: '.ttf', dataBase64: '' }); return 1

const im = new Image(); im.src = 'data:image/png;base64,'; await im.decode(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = im.width; c.height = im.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0);
  const n = addProjectImage('fw/cover.png', c, {}).name; await loadAllImages(); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: n }); e.name = 'Cover'; e.src = n; e.x = 0; e.y = 0; e.show = 'normal'; Object.assign(e, {}); return n

const im = new Image(); im.src = 'data:image/png;base64,'; await im.decode(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = im.width; c.height = im.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0);
  const n = addProjectImage('fw/plate.png', c, {}).name; await loadAllImages(); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: n }); e.name = 'Centre plate'; e.src = n; e.x = 155; e.y = 185; e.show = 'normal'; Object.assign(e, {}); return n

const im = new Image(); im.src = 'data:image/png;base64,'; await im.decode(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = im.width; c.height = im.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0);
  const n = addProjectImage('fw/dial.png', c, {}).name; await loadAllImages(); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: n }); e.name = 'Dial'; e.src = n; e.x = 149; e.y = 179; e.show = 'normal'; Object.assign(e, {}); return n
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n - 3, n - 2, n - 1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

project.elements = project.elements.filter((e) => !/^Colon/.test(e.name)); project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gClockAod = 'Clock AOD'; for (const e of project.elements) if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name)) e.group = 'gClockAod'; return project.elements.map((e) => e.name).join(',')
